description: This PHP source file defines an interface for character streams used in the ANTLR lexer framework, along with a constants class and some configuration variables.

classes.name: CharStreamConst
classes.description: A class holding a constant value representing the end-of-file token for character streams.

methods.name: substring
methods.description: Returns a substring of characters from the stream between start and stop positions.

methods.name: LT
methods.description: Provides lookahead at the ith character in the stream.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Retrieves the current line number in the input stream.

methods.name: setLine
methods.description: Sets the current line number in the input stream.

methods.name: setCharPositionInLine
methods.description: Sets the character position within the current line.

methods.name: getCharPositionInLine
methods.description: Gets the current character position within the line.
